payload.description: You don't need an IDE, an MCP, or any complex setup. Just a chat window and a willingness to be wrong. This guide walks you through using AI's reasoning capabilities to battle-test your assumptions, sharpen your strategies, and build clearer thinking — inspired by Nathan Mapp, CPA.
payload.name: How to Use AI to Stress-Test Your Ideas and Strategies
